pages: Hemi, a boy of ten with short black hair, a green wool jersey with a yellow collar and dark shorts, crouches on the harbour wall and looks down into one dark rock pool. Middle distance: weed-fringed stones, the square blocks of the wall. Background: low tide, sea drawing back over wet sand, flat grey afternoon light.

Hemi, a boy of ten with short black hair, a green wool jersey with a yellow collar and dark shorts, measures the mouth of one spiral whelk shell with a small wooden ruler, bigger shells in a row beside it. Middle distance: the flat stone, his boot, the pool edge. Background: harbour wall, wet rock, low afternoon light.

Hemi, a boy of ten with short black hair, a green wool jersey with a yellow collar and dark shorts, holds very still with one hand open above the pool as a small brown animal walks sideways into it. Middle distance: one spiral whelk shell, weed, ripples. Background: wet stones in the harbour wall, the tide out, grey afternoon light.

Hemi, a boy of ten with short black hair, a green wool jersey with a yellow collar and dark shorts, lifts one spiral whelk shell mouth-up in his fingertips and looks into it. Middle distance: a galvanised bait bucket, the pool lip, weed. Background: harbour wall blocks, low tide, grey light on wet stone.

Hemi, a boy of ten with short black hair, a green wool jersey with a yellow collar and dark shorts, sets one spiral whelk shell mouth-up on the flat stone and counts the legs of the small brown animal beside it. Middle distance: his pointing hand, its one big claw, wet pebbles. Background: the pool, harbour wall, grey afternoon light.

Hemi, a boy of ten with short black hair, a green wool jersey with a yellow collar and dark shorts, kneels at the pool with one galvanised bait bucket beside him and lowers the animal into the deep end. Middle distance: the bucket, ripples, the borrowed shell. Background: weed and wet stone, harbour wall, flat grey light.

Hemi, a boy of ten with short black hair, a green wool jersey with a yellow collar and dark shorts, turns one whelk shell over with a fingertip and looks at the silt packed in its mouth. Middle distance: the small brown animal on the stone, the pool, weed. Background: wet harbour wall rock, tide out, grey afternoon light.

Hemi, a boy of ten with short black hair, a green wool jersey with a yellow collar and dark shorts, sits on the harbour wall and slides one flat stone of shells along with his fingertip. Middle distance: his wooden ruler, spiral shells in a row, the pool below. Background: low water and wet sand, evening light going grey.

Hemi, a boy of ten with short black hair, a green wool jersey with a yellow collar and dark shorts, lets one spiral whelk shell go just under the surface, his fingertips breaking the water at the pool rim. Middle distance: the shell sinking, ripples, weed. Background: harbour wall stones, evening light, the low tide showing.

Hemi, a boy of ten with short black hair, a green wool jersey with a yellow collar and dark shorts, rubs a line of pencil marks down his bare forearm with one finger. Middle distance: a pencil stub, spiral shells on the flat stone, the pool rim. Background: the harbour wall in flat evening light, water over the top pool.

Hemi, a boy of ten with short black hair, a green wool jersey with a yellow collar and dark shorts, holds one large spiral whelk shell in his palm as the small brown animal backs into its mouth. Middle distance: shells in a row on the stone, wet wall, weed. Background: the ramp in rain, grey water, low tide.

Hemi, a boy of ten with short black hair, a green wool jersey with a yellow collar and dark shorts, puts one pencil stub into his shorts pocket and looks down at his marked forearm. Middle distance: the ramp rail, wet harbour wall, his marked arm. Background: rain over the harbour, flat grey light, the sea running back in.
